description: This file contains the implementation of in-memory, volatile storage classes for Orleans state machine journaling, including a provider class and a storage class with methods for reading, appending, replacing, and deleting log segments.

classes.name: VolatileStateMachineStorageProvider
classes.description: Provides in-memory, volatile storage for Orleans state machines, managing storage instances per grain context.

classes.name: VolatileStateMachineStorage
classes.description: Implements in-memory storage for state machine logs, supporting read, append, replace, and delete operations.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a volatile storage instance for a given grain context.

methods.name: ReadAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously reads log segments as an async stream.

methods.name: AppendAsync
methods.description: Appends a new log segment to the storage.

methods.name: ReplaceAsync
methods.description: Replaces current log segments with a new snapshot.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Deletes all log segments from storage.
